title: Enhancement of Both Faraday and Kerr Effects with an All-Dielectric Grating Based on a Magneto-Optical Nanocomposite Material
original_article_license: ACS AuthorChoice, non-commercial copying/redistribution terms; see publication. Only numerical facts and original provenance notes are reproduced here.
material: CoFe2O4 nanoparticles in TEOS-derived silica sol-gel
measurement_note: Refractive index measured by ellipsometry in an area without Si3N4 grating. Off-diagonal value is reported as corresponding to the nanoparticle volume fraction; not a complete separately measured tensor spectrum for every coated slit.
magnetic_state: Room-temperature saturated magneto-optical spectra; applied-field sweep in the experiment 0 to 0.8 T. A calibrated M(H) curve is not included.
